mission.title: Education that reaches every student
mission.description: Many students across Nepal still have limited access to experienced teachers, updated learning resources, and modern digital education. We're building a platform where distance, resources, or background don't determine the quality of education a student receives.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes! Core curriculum learning, daily challenges, and community features are free. Premium courses, advanced features, and some live classes may require a subscription.
faq.a2: We currently support Grade 1 through +2 (Grade 12), aligned with the Nepal NEB curriculum.
faq.a3: No. Padhai is designed for low-bandwidth connections. Enable Data Saver mode for the best experience on slow connections. You can also download lessons for offline learning.
faq.a4: Yes. Parents can create an account and link it to their child's profile to see attendance, progress, test results, and upcoming classes.
faq.a5: Live classes are held every evening at 7 PM NPT. You can join from your phone or computer, ask questions, participate in polls, and access class recordings later.
faq.a6: Absolutely. We follow strict privacy and security practices, especially for student data. We collect minimal personal information and never share it with third parties.
